New nonblank contents or formulas in non-anchor cells of merged ranges are hidden worksheet inputs. Reject these additions/changes generically and exclude merged interiors from region-text fact matching. Existing blank/style-only interior nodes and unchanged source contents are not failures. mc:Ignorable is a lexical namespace-prefix list. XML prefix renaming does not preserve conformance if these tokens become undeclared. Add a generic scope-aware structure check, preserving financial-fact diagnostics. This corrects one true false pass and is separate from the three documented oracle relaxations; actual native Excel acceptance/repair of this output remains unverified.
